Parent #1925 / #1645. Scoped child that completes the **tmux capture** half of parent #1645 SC-04; the bounded Agent event-log half is #2016. Design: `docs/design/terminal/ahp-inspired-terminal-consistency.md`.

## Requirements: Declare the control-channel attach barrier as an atomic stream cut at epoch start

### Problem

`ControlModeSession::attach` already takes its bootstrap capture on the control channel and drops `%output` that the capture covers (`BarrierPhase`/`ControlRouter` in `crates/nession-agent/src/tmux/control.rs`). A producer straddling the attach lands each line exactly once across capture ∪ live stream — already proven by `the_bootstrap_capture_and_the_live_stream_join_exactly`.

The wire still marks every tmux capture `cutConsistency=unverified` with no `streamEpoch`/`throughSeq` (`send_bootstrap`). So the browser's only production-reachable verified baseline is the already-attached event-log prefix; a first attach can never establish a parser position, and parent #1645 SC-04 keeps failing on "external tmux capture cut remains unverified".

The barrier's cut is at **stream position 0**: the session stream is created with the attach, the capture covers everything before it, and every live event recorded afterwards is seq 1 or later. That is a provable cut of the *stream*; it says nothing about VT fidelity, which remains `screen-only`/`partial`.

### Scope

- Let `send_bootstrap` carry a cut description instead of a constant: the control-channel attach barrier yields `atomic`, `stream_epoch = <session epoch>`, `through_seq = 0`; the separate-process PTY capture and the already-attached fallback stay `unverified` with no epoch/seq.
- Never promote truncation, capture failure, a skipped barrier, or mode loss to a full-VT claim. Fidelity stays `screen-only`/`partial`; `truncated` still describes the screen snapshot only.
- Browser: a `throughSeq = 0` atomic marker establishes `appliedThrough = 0` for that epoch without erasing scrollback (no replay follows), and the first live event advances/ACKs. A marker with `throughSeq > 0` keeps the existing complete-replay requirements. Unverified markers still establish nothing.
- No ControlLease/input ACK changes, no Relay/P2P sequencing changes, no VT emulator.

### No new browser E2E obligation

The proof is deterministic Rust integration (real tmux, concurrent producer/resize) plus web unit tests. `### New` declares no new browser spec; regression `terminal-attach-bootstrap` guards attach bootstrap wiring.

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 Control-mode attach bootstrap declares `cutConsistency=atomic` with the session `streamEpoch` and `throughSeq=0` **only** when the capture came from the control-channel barrier; fidelity remains screen-only/partial and truncation is separate.
- [ ] SC-02 Separate-process PTY capture, already-attached fallback, failed/skipped barrier and capture-less attaches declare no atomic marker and no epoch/throughSeq.
- [ ] SC-03 Under a producer (and authoritative resize) straddling the attach, every line appears exactly once across capture ∪ live stream, and the first recorded live event is seq 1.
- [ ] SC-04 A renderer that parses the epoch-start marker establishes `appliedThrough=0` for that epoch without a buffer wipe; the first live event advances and is ACK-eligible. An unverified marker establishes nothing.
- [ ] SC-05 Exact PR HEAD Quality / E2E / Case Smoke / trusted Acceptance, and exact merge-SHA Quality / E2E / Cases / Orchestrator Pass.
